item: R153 read fold: a curated stamp never admits a sibling of a disqualified outlet, and the seeder, import and restore say what they do
summary: The independent read of R153/R154/L2 found that a feed made by the CSV/YAML import or POST /sources under a locally disqualified catalogue outlet was stamped curated-qualified at the next boot with no measurement and collected. stamp_curated_catalog now skips an unqualified row whose outlet has a disqualified feed (any row of the domain, in scope or not) and counts it as outlet_disqualified. The sibling step's one IN over every created domain is chunked (it failed on a 999-variable SQLite on a first boot), a feed-less import line no longer counts as a second feed so a correction beside it is still a correction, the seeder's left_to_own_trial is renamed left_unjudged because the trial never happened on a catalogue domain, a no-op admission-audit call is gone, and a feed disqualified on its own evidence is reported with its own rule. Each has a test that was shown red without the change.
